download.note: Includes 132 curated dataset files and 35 original crash recipe files; 2 small source decks downloaded separately for units/license inspection.

cpu_custom_trial.note: This initial CPU process predated the device/checkpoint/source-snapshot additions. Its log is functional evidence, not a completed performance experiment.

official_driver_cpu_trial.compatibility_fix: Generalize displacement_t0.xxx regex to displacement_t<number>.<digits> so t10..100 ms fields are read.
official_driver_cpu_trial.reader_selfcheck: Original Run100 load shape (1,13676,3); compatibility copy shape (11,13676,3), assert passed.
official_driver_cpu_trial.claim: Stock training driver, preprocessing, optimizer, validation and checkpoint path verified on a tiny subset; predictive accuracy not established.

gpu_field_trial.note: New lightweight driver using official installed Transolver class; full original recipe reproduction is not claimed.

source_model_license: Altair CC BY-NC 4.0 as declared in both source deck headers
data_scope: Fixed aligned mesh, varying shell thickness and pole offset, constant initial velocity -5 mm/ms. Curated targets contain displacement, not stress/plastic strain/fracture.

full_mesh_training_trial.architecture_and_split: Same as gpu1024; kernel fitting skipped to reduce host memory.
full_mesh_training_trial.reason: Scale experiment selected from measured full-node step time/memory before evaluation, not heldout score tuning.
full_mesh_training_trial.pure_inference_reuse: passed; max absolute difference0.0mm; matching mesh hash checked

full_mesh_sampled_model_probe.scope: 1024-node training checkpoint evaluated at13675nodes; full-node training was not part of this probe.

capacity_ablation.execution_gate: Actual step peak GPU tensor allocation<2GB and estimated60epoch training with10percent overhead<300seconds
capacity_ablation.interpretation: Exploratory one-seed capacity comparison. Mean improves but largest local vector error and translation-removed relative error worsen; no convergence or universal ranking claim.
